# `foxglove auth configure-api-key`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](auth.md)

```text
Configure an API key

Usage: foxglove auth configure-api-key [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --api-key <API_KEY>
          API key for non-interactive use

      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --base-url <BASE_URL>
          API server (default: https://api.foxglove.dev)

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
